title: DECISION: Saturating arithmetic for scroll navigation
description:
What: PageUp and PageDown operations use saturating_sub() to prevent underflow. PageUp does scroll_offset += height; PageDown does scroll_offset = scroll_offset.saturating_sub(height). Then clamp_scroll() ensures the result fits in [0, max_offset].

Why it's good: Scroll offset is a visual position, not a buffer index. Saturation arithmetic is the right primitive: if you scroll down past the bottom, stay at bottom; if you scroll up past the top, stay at top. No panics on edge cases. The two-step approach (saturating arithmetic + clamping) separates concerns: first we apply the user action, then we enforce bounds. Tested implicitly by e2e test exercising multiple chat loads.
